title: Exported Luau types and typed member autocomplete
changes: Only export type aliases are offered as Module.Type in imported scripts
Infer exported typeof(data) fields from a module's local data table
Limit annotated data. member suggestions to its declared exported type
Support literal record types, nested fields and private internal aliases
Keep type-only completions separate from value methods and WASM suggestions
Preserve workspace file format, editor geometry and original Luau runtime
